title: Skeptical cinematographer Michael convinced by the Mia tests

tellings.quote: generally a skeptic in my life for most things but through seeing this I can't it's hard for me to not believe this stuff

plain: A film cameraman named Michael, who worked on a documentary by filmmaker Ky Dickens about children said to read minds, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about filming tests with a girl named Mia in Glendale, California, around 2023. He says he has been a skeptic about most things in his life, but after seeing these tests it is hard for him not to believe. If the tests are what he says, it would mean telepathy, reading thoughts without words, is real.
